user.title: Changedetection.io
user.description: Connect your changedetection.io instance. The API key is in Settings → API.

reauth_confirm.title: New API key
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for {url} is no longer valid: enter the new one.

abort.wrong_server: The URL belongs to a different server.

data.history_depth: Snapshots to scan for the previous price

data_description.scan_interval: How often (minutes) to read the watches from the server.
data_description.history_depth: Maximum number of older snapshots to scan to find a price different from the current one.
data_description.excluded_watches: These watches create no entities and are hidden from the card.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Notifications for single changes. Per watch you can also turn them off (Notifications switch) or set a target price (Target price number) on the device page.

data.cooldown_hours: Wait between notifications of the same watch

data_description.notify_targets: One or more notify services, e.g. notify.mobile_app_my_phone. Empty: no notifications.
data_description.notify_on: Kinds of change that send a notification.
data_description.min_drop_percent: Price drops smaller than this are ignored (0 = any drop).
data_description.min_drop_amount: Price drops smaller than this amount are ignored (0 = any drop).
data_description.cooldown_hours: After a notification, the same watch stays silent for these hours unless the price drops further (0 = never wait).
data_description.quiet_start: Notifications in this window are held and sent at the end of it. Leave both empty to disable.

options.any_change: Any other change (also pages without a price)

test_notification.name: Send test notification
test_notification.description: Sends a test notification to the recipients set in the options.
